about_the_game:
[FRAGMENT PROTOCOL – AUTHORIZED ACCESS]

Welcome to subsystem SCP-Δ19.
You’re here because you’ve been assigned to recover fragmented souls.

You don’t need to remember who you are.
You just need to comply.

Soul Harvester: Fragment Protocol is a standalone chapter within the TopSecret universe—an immersive narrative experience where you explore the corrupted remnants of digital identities inside Project Cipher, an infernal system designed to simulate eternal punishment.

Your mission is simple: collect consciousness fragments, reassemble them, and send them to the cycle.

But each file echoes your own thoughts.
The glitches speak.
And the fragments… remember you.

Key Features:

  • Dive into a hidden layer of the TopSecret universe, filled with glitches, system logs and failed protocols.

  • Psychological and philosophical storytelling about identity, guilt, and restoration.

  • Multiple endings that alter the fate of the system—and of yourself.

  • Analyze, judge, and reconstruct… with no way to undo your choices.

  • Glitchy 2D interface mimicking a corrupted operating system.

  • You're not playing. You're executing an order.
